answers.ask: The arcade setting implies neon and retro - is that right, or did you want a cleaner modern arcade?
answers.answer: Go with a neon retro arcade look.

answers.ask: Is this round-based with one seeker and a timer, or free-form finding?
answers.answer: Make it round-based with one seeker and a timer, like hide and seek.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D hide-and-seek map set inside a large neon retro arcade, with rows of glowing arcade cabinets, game machines, prize counters, seating areas, and back corridors arranged to create clear hiding spaces.
agent_notes: Finding people round-based with one seeker and a timer is hide-and-seek, so Party & Casual and its Childhood Game preset. The author's whole map is one big arcade, so I took interior-single from the shared catalogue over the genre's default space-bounded: both route the same, but interior-single states the thing that matters to the build, that the venue is the entire map with no exterior to generate and no inside-outside transition to link, which keeps it off P3. obstacle-maze was dropped because a big arcade was described as a place rather than a warren, and cover-los carries the dense rows of cabinets that do the sightline-breaking work here. Without a user I decided the between-rounds gathering space is the arcade's own entrance floor rather than a separate lobby, so nothing needs staging; the neon retro palette is art direction rather than an option.
